paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between "the length of gold prefix" and BLEU score for two models. The x-axis is labeled "the length of gold prefix" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels displayed at increments of 5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale ranging from 23 to 29, with tick labels displayed at increments of 1. A blue, dashed line with circular markers represents "Consistency-CE" and begins at a value of approximately 24.8 at x=0, decreases to approximately 23.8 at x=5, increases to around 26.7 at x=10, and terminates at approximately 27.3 at x=20. A red, solid line with square markers represents "Consistency-Bi" and starts at around 27.4 at x=0, declines to approximately 24.6 at x=10, and ends at around 24.4 at x=20.
